title: NEW Northern Lights Grand Tour! ✨ MSFS 2024 Marketplace Activities Update (Week of Jan 19, 2026)
description:
This week’s Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 Marketplace update brings a fresh dose of adventure for activity‑focused simmers — and in this video, I’ll walk you through the brand‑new mission pack that just landed on PC! ✈️🌌

We’re zooming in on the latest activities added to the MSFS 2024 Marketplace, with a spotlight on a single but exciting new release: a multi‑leg Northern Lights tour designed to immerse you in one of aviation’s most magical visual experiences. If you love structured missions, scenic exploration, or guided adventures, this week’s update has something special for you.

✈️ New activities added this week (PC)  
The following activity (missions & miscellaneous) was newly released in the marketplace this week:

🗺️ Perfect Flight – 8LEGS GRAND TOUR – NORTHERN LIGHTS
